title: Scripting queued property callbacks borrow cache pointers that can be reallocated
summary: Category security; severity medium; confidence high from source lifetime contract; Location: indigo_drivers/agent_scripting/indigo_agent_scripting.c:455-463,:477-483,:499,:725. Define/redefine/update callbacks receive the live cached property pointer as queued data. A later definition of the same named property resizes/reallocates that same cached object when more items are required; indigo_resize_property (indigo_libs/indigo_bus.c:1605-1607) calls realloc for non-BLOB growth. Pending handlers still hold the previous pointer. execute_script:1046-1058 evaluates ordinary script calls synchronously under the scripting mutex, while indigo_execute_handler_with_data enqueues work (indigo_driver.c:2266-2268, queue contract2221-2230). There is no property copy, reference-counted stable indirection or queue drain before mutation. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (FM-7). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
